system.description:
Lore: Relic Scroll (Consumable)

Confiscated from Dzaan, and offered back as a reward. It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Holds a single Casting of @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.TB8OU9AcPKGWBxwA]{Erupt}, at the Rank it was scribed. Reading it aloud Casts the Spell without spending Mana and consumes the scroll.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
